description: Source code implementing ASN1_OBJECT handling functions in OpenSSL, including encoding, decoding, creation, and memory management of ASN1_OBJECT structures.

classes.name: ASN1_OBJECT
classes.description: Structure representing an ASN.1 object identifier, including fields for data, length, NID, short and long names, and flags.

methods.name: i2d_ASN1_OBJECT
methods.description: Serializes an ASN1_OBJECT into DER format.

methods.name: i2t_ASN1_OBJECT
methods.description: Converts ASN1_OBJECT to its textual representation.

methods.name: i2a_ASN1_OBJECT
methods.description: Writes ASN1_OBJECT as a string to a BIO.

methods.name: d2i_ASN1_OBJECT
methods.description: Decodes DER-encoded ASN1_OBJECT from input buffer.

methods.name: ASN1_OBJECT_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new ASN1_OBJECT.

methods.name: ASN1_OBJECT_create
methods.description: Creates an ASN1_OBJECT with specified parameters.
